scope: Desktop archived reports; Mac exploration is analyzed separately in mac-analysis.json.

definitions.dev_trajectory: Eligible correct dev validations from report.steps, timestamped at validation end; carry max observed score until loop end.
definitions.wall_time: report.timing.wall_clock_total_s; includes final; startup diagnostic overlaps measured stages.
definitions.cost: Frozen comparison price snapshots applied to report usage by model; unknown usage yields null total with known subtotal.
definitions.replication: 15 feedback episodes; 4 routing episodes; 2 started stopped-batch episodes, kept separate.
